notes.title: Coming soon...
notes.notes:
We are in the final steps of development now, aiming for a release on March 13th. Steam leaderboards are in development, endless mode has been implemented, and things are moving along quickly. 

Hopefully we'll have much to show by the release date, and perhaps a beta program leading up to release.

Stay tuned for more details.
